why_trail.why: Read handoff (task=build pooled field reference lap for one weekend, protected intent=pooled-not-per-lap, DB-only, no thresholds), ribbon.build_ribbon (median-pooled XY geometry, per-lap u=s/s[-1] resample+median, periodic curvature), session_fit.load_quali_session (store-first FastF1-shaped shim returning (session,rho,rho_is_fallback)), telemetry_session.DBSession (car_data/pos_data keyed by driver NUMBER, laps df has Driver/LapNumber/Stint/LapTime/LapStartTime/Time, no PitInTime/PitOutTime columns), loaders.driver_streams (metres/m/s unit conversion). Handoff is complete: task, scope, exclusions, evidence, test mode, stop conditions all present.

test_reference_lap.py written with 6 test cases (grid alignment, median-not-mean speed pooling incl. non-symmetric set, brake-active-fraction pooling, geometry parity with direct build_ribbon call, min_laps ValueError, mismatched-channel-length ValueError). Ran on pinned interpreter: 6 failed with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named src.physics.segment_map.derivation -- confirms RED, module does not exist yet.

Implemented ReferenceLap frozen dataclass (distance_m/curvature/v_ref/brake_active_frac/px/py/lap_length_m/n_laps_pooled) with __post_init__ shape+monotone+finite validation, and build_reference_lap: reuses ribbon.build_ribbon verbatim for geometry (px,py,curvature,distance_m unmodified), resamples each lap's own arc-length progress u=s/s[-1] (identical formula to build_ribbon's internal per-lap parameterisation) for speed (linear interp, median-pooled) and brake (nearest-sample per ribbon.drs_zone_mask's convention, mean-pooled into an active-fraction). All 6 synthetic tests green on first attempt: grid alignment, median-not-mean speed pooling (symmetric+skewed sets), brake-fraction pooling, exact geometry parity vs direct build_ribbon call, min_laps ValueError, mismatched-channel-length ValueError.

Implemented reference_lap_from_store: calls session_fit.load_quali_session(year,gp_name,session_type) for the store-first FastF1-shaped session shim (returns (session,rho,rho_is_fallback)); iterates session.drivers (numbers for DBSession), falls back to abbreviation via session.get_driver(num)['Abbreviation'] for session.laps.pick_drivers since tele_laps.driver stores the ABBREVIATION not the number (confirmed via direct sqlite inspection of the real store: tele_laps columns [session_id,driver,lap_number,stint,lap_time_s,lap_start_time_s,lap_end_time_s], driver='RIC' etc). Per-lap clean-flying filter = LapTime.notna() and >50s (session_fit's own existing floor, not a new threshold). XY from driver_streams (metres); speed linearly interpolated from car_data onto position sample times; brake from session.car_data[num]['Brake'] nearest-sampled onto position times (bool, nonzero=braking) -- all three channels now parallel arrays per build_reference_lap's contract. Added a real-store smoke test (skips cleanly via Path(DEFAULT_STORE_PATH).exists() guard) -- ran end-to-end against 2026 Australia Q from the actual telemetry_store.db at C:/Programs/f1Brainz/data/telemetry_store.db: 246 laps pooled, lap_length_m=5223.4 (Albert Park nominal ~5278m, plausible for smoothed pooled geometry), v_ref in [25.8,79.8] m/s, brake_active_frac in [0,0.96], curvature in [-0.032,0.034] 1/m -- all physically plausible. Full derivation suite: 7 passed (6 synthetic + 1 real-store smoke), 0 skipped since the store IS present in this environment.

Both Required Evidence commands ran clean on the pinned interpreter: pytest 7/7 passed (6 synthetic + 1 real-store smoke against 2026 Australia Q, 246 laps pooled); simplification_limits PASS (1 file checked). git check-ignore exits 1 on all 4 new files (Deliverable Path Check satisfied). IMPLEMENTER_RESULT written to .agent-work/662-segment-map/g1-impl-result.md with pasted evidence, store seam (session_fit.load_quali_session return shape), brake source field (session.car_data[num]['Brake']), assumptions (clean-lap filter reuses existing 50s floor, parallel-array per-lap channel contract, nearest-sample brake resampling matching drs_zone_mask precedent), no stop conditions hit, one forward-looking out-of-scope note (DBSession lacks PitInTime/PitOutTime columns, a future _get_clean_laps reuse trap), and full workflow feedback (abbreviation-vs-number keying discovery, arc-length-vs-index-proxy ambiguity in the handoff's Close Criteria).
